# free forever

> A directory of 42 AI coding tools, sorted by how free they actually are: 13 free forever (no card, no expiry), 24 limited (a real allowance that runs out) and 5 reference. Every allowance was read from the vendor's own page or from a directory that re-probes its rows, and every entry carries the catch the landing page does not mention. Last read 26 Nov 2026.

This file is for language models and agents. Humans should use https://e4crypt3d.github.io/free-forever/.

Machine-readable copies of the same data:

- [feed.json](https://e4crypt3d.github.io/free-forever/feed.json) — every entry as JSON (id, name, url, tier, free allowance, who pays, the catch as an array, licence, platforms, sources, verification date).
- [llms-full.txt](https://e4crypt3d.github.io/free-forever/llms-full.txt) — every entry in full Markdown.

How to read the tiers:

- **Free forever** — no card, no expiry. Who pays next month is an advertiser, a vendor, a university or your own hardware.
- **Limited free** — a genuine free allowance that runs out. Treat a one-time grant or an unpublished number as a trial.
- **Reference** — not tools: directories that probe their own rows, and student bundles.

Quoting: the entries are summaries of vendors' published numbers, with the source and date on each. Quote the date with the number; free tiers rot fast.

## Entries

- [freecode](https://freecode.sh/) — Free forever — Free access with a daily usage limit; the site says access resets and tells you when.
- [Freebuff](https://freebuff.com/) — Free forever — 30 hours a day on the free plan — but only in the vendor's 24 “full access” countries. Anywhere else it is 5 hours a day, and 4 over a VPN or proxy. One-hour sessions with unlimited messages; hours reset at midnight in your local timezone and do not roll over.
- [free-pi](https://freepi.ai/) — Free forever — A daily allowance set by the server — the limits docs deliberately do not state a number. /usage shows a percentage; a warning appears at 80%.
- [Tenzy](https://tenzy.net/) — Free forever — Fair-use budget of 20h 35m of agent time per cycle, resetting every 15 hours. No card to install.
- [VibeFree](https://vibefree.dev/) — Free forever — Guest chat needs no account — an advert pays for each message. An account adds a free daily token allowance and VibeBucks.
- [ADCode](https://adcode.bluethenics.com/) — Free forever — 140 AI credits a day across included models — roughly 20 agent steps a day, per their own comparison.
- [Clixad](https://clixad.io/) — Free forever — Seven models free every day up to 60,000 credits of usage per account, inside a daily budget shared by all users; Gemini 3.8 Flash joins them until 15 January 2027. The 25,000-credit signup bonus is gone.
- [Idlen](https://www.idlen.io/) — Free forever — $0 to install. You keep 70% of the ad revenue the wait earns, paid via Stripe, PayPal or as credits.
- [idlepay](https://www.idlepay.co/) — Free forever — Free to install, no card, 50% revenue share, cash out via Stripe past $10.
- [Overbrilliant OB-1](https://github.com/Overbrilliant/ob-1) — Free forever — A built-in free-models router — the project documents 150+ free models across 20+ providers — starts with no key or account; new free models reach free users after 30 days.
- [opencode](https://opencode.ai/) — Free forever — Free-tier chat models, usable inside OpenCode with no key or card.
- [Google Antigravity](https://antigravity.google/) — Free forever — $0 plan serving gemini-3.8-flash, claude-opus-4.6, claude-sonnet-4.6 and gpt-oss-120b — all four listed “until 2026-11-30”.
- [Ollama (local models)](https://ollama.com/) — Free forever — Download, pull a model, run it. No key, no account, no card, no telemetry to a vendor.
- [Kilo Code](https://kilo.ai/pricing) — Limited free — An Auto Free mode plus a keyless OpenAI-compatible gateway on a handful of free open models.
- [Kiro](https://kiro.dev/) — Limited free — A perpetual free tier on Claude Sonnet and open-weight models — 50 credits a month, non-rolling, on requests served from the US; successor to Amazon Q Developer.
- [Google Jules](https://jules.google/) — Limited free — 15 async tasks per rolling day, 3 at a time, on Gemini models.
- [Duck.ai](https://duck.ai/) — Limited free — Six models signed out: GPT-6 Luna, GPT-5.4 mini, Claude 4.5 Haiku, Mistral Small 4, gpt-oss-120b, Gemma 4 31B.
- [Autohand Code](https://docs.autohand.ai/getting-started/plans-and-pricing/free) — Limited free — 15 credits per rolling 5-hour window, up to 100 a month — one credit is one successful hosted response.
- [WorkBuddy](https://www.workbuddy.ai/docs/workbuddy/pricing) — Limited free — 100 credits a month, 5,000 code completions a month, 3 automated tasks — plus a limited-time promo of 30 credits a day.
- [DeepAI](https://deepai.org/pricing) — Limited free — Limited HD images and editing, limited standard chat, up to 250 “Theos” a day in DeepAI Code, 60s/day of voice chat.
- [Cursor (Hobby)](https://cursor.com/pricing) — Limited free — A limited free allotment of agent requests and completions on the Hobby plan.
- [TRAE (TraeCode)](https://www.trae.ai/pricing) — Limited free — Auto mode only on the free plan, plus a one-time Basic usage allowance and limited autocompletion.
- [Qoder](https://qoder.com/pricing) — Limited free — Ongoing free basic-model allowance, a Qwen promotion, a 300-credit Pro trial and daily credits to claim.
- [GitHub Copilot Free](https://github.com/features/copilot) — Limited free — A free individual plan: 2,000 completions a month plus a chat and agent allowance GitHub does not put a number on.
- [Codex (ChatGPT Free)](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/pricing) — Limited free — Codex on the Free plan, subject to rollout; unlimited text chat with GPT-6 Luna.
- [Macaly](https://macaly.com/pricing) — Limited free — 1 published app on a Macaly domain, 1M monthly credits, limited usage through ChatGPT and Claude.
- [bolt.new](https://bolt.new/) — Limited free — A monthly token allowance on the free plan, public and private projects, website hosting.
- [Google AI Studio (Gemini API)](https://aistudio.google.com/) — Limited free — A free tier on the Gemini API — Gemini 3.8 Flash, 3.6 Flash, Gemma 4 and others.
- [Groq](https://groq.com/) — Limited free — Free plan on gpt-oss-120b, gpt-oss-20b and Qwen 3.8 27B with published limits.
- [NVIDIA NIM](https://build.nvidia.com/) — Limited free — Free endpoints on models NVIDIA marks “Free Endpoint”, including GLM, Nemotron, Gemma and gpt-oss.
- [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai/) — Limited free — Models priced at zero, and an `openrouter/free` router that picks one at random for each request.
- [FreeInference (Harvard SEAS)](https://freeinference.org/) — Limited free — Free open models — DeepSeek V4 Flash, GLM 5.3 Flash, MiniMax M3, Qwen 3.6 — over OpenAI and Anthropic-shaped endpoints.
- [LLM7.io](https://llm7.io/) — Limited free — 100,000 input plus output tokens a day on eligible turbo models.
- [OVHcloud AI Endpoints](https://www.ovhcloud.com/en/public-cloud/ai-endpoints/catalog/) — Limited free — Anonymous OpenAI-compatible calls to gpt-oss-120b, Qwen 3.6 and Qwen 3.8 27B.
- [Z.ai (Zhipu GLM)](https://z.ai/) — Limited free — GLM 4.7 Flash, 4.5 Flash and 4.6V Flash at zero price.
- [Cloudflare Workers AI](https://www.cloudflare.com/products/workers-ai/) — Limited free — A daily free allowance of “neurons” across hosted open models.
- [Pollinations.AI](https://pollinations.ai/) — Limited free — An anonymous legacy text endpoint on text.pollinations.ai (gpt-oss-20b). The current gen.pollinations.ai API needs a key and bills Pollen credits.
- [awesome-free-ai-coding](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/) — Reference — MIT licensed. No tracking, no ads, no affiliate links.
- [freellm.site](https://www.freellm.site/) — Reference — Free to read; 29 providers marked “always free”.
- [VibeLedger free-tools index](https://vibeledger.dev/free-ai-coding-tools/) — Reference — Free to read; checked 31 October 2026.
- [GitHub Student Developer Pack](https://education.github.com/pack) — Reference — Cloud credit, JetBrains IDEs, domains and more, donated by partners.
- [Azure for Students](https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/free/students/) — Reference — $100 credit per year, renewable while enrolled.
